title: Curse of Unlooting
description: This project adds a new enchantment called, "Curse of Unlooting" and is basically the opposite of looting.
body:
## **Main Information**

Simple mod that adds 1 new book

_Curse of Unlooting_

It is the opposite of looting, if you don't understand this showcase will explain it

[Showcase Video (Quality isn't the best)](https://image2url.com/r2/default/videos/1775065353626-65a4d9c3-a27e-479b-a08d-a3c10c504c16.mp4)

The enchantment can be used for good and bad, If you are playing multiplayer and someone enchants your sword with Curse of Unlooting then you wont be able to get mob loots but if you are making a mob farm the enchant can be used if you just want experience!

## **Alternate Ways to Download Curse of Unlooting**
